description: This file is a test script for retrieving parameter values from the WECB component using the tdklib wrapper. It contains test logic to connect to a device, execute a specific test step (`WECB_GetParamValues`), and handle success or failure scenarios. The script is designed for testing device parameters related to the WECB component, specifically focusing on the 'Device.MoCA.' parameter.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to interact with various test component modules, including creating test steps, retrieving module load status, configuring test cases, and managing module load states.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for a specified test interface or method.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of whether the test module loaded successfully.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the module load process, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the current test case with target IP, port, and test case name.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds input parameters to the test step, such as 'paramName'.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the configured test case and prepares the result for retrieval.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Obtains the result status ('SUCCESS' or 'FAILURE') after executing a test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output or response after test execution.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the overall success or failure status for the test step.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the currently loaded test module.
